verdict.rationale: The evidence shows some user-tunable low-level engine controls: a user set N_GPU_LAYERS to control GPU offload, and CPU/GPU model splitting is documented. The mmap evidence describes an engine change rather than a user-facing override. missing for 10: documented flags to toggle mmap or enable memory locking (mlock), first-party docs listing engine overrides for the server/CLI, and hands-on corroboration of overriding memory-mapping defaults.
